stats.name: base_action_points
stats.semantic_role: per-type maximum action-point budget before fatigue penalties
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseActionPoints`, copied into slot +8 on init, and used by `UnitSlot_CalcActionPointsFromFatigue`.

stats.name: current_action_points
stats.semantic_role: runtime action points available to the slot this turn
stats.evidence: Lives at UnitSlotRecord +8 and is refreshed each new turn from the base AP table after fatigue thresholds are applied.

stats.name: current_health_percent
stats.semantic_role: runtime health or squad strength percentage
stats.evidence: Initialized to 100, scales effective attack and damage helpers, and a zero value kills the slot.

stats.name: fatigue
stats.semantic_role: runtime exhaustion counter that throttles action points and morale
stats.evidence: Lives at UnitSlotRecord +10, drops by 20 on recovery turns, and thresholds at 80/90/100 reduce available action points.

stats.name: morale
stats.semantic_role: runtime 0-20 morale/obedience score that boosts combat stats and can cause order refusal
stats.evidence: Lives at UnitSlotRecord +11, is clamped to 0..20, adds into attack and damage helpers, and drives the low-morale refusal flag.

stats.name: stance_bits
stats.semantic_role: runtime formation or stance bits that modify attack values
stats.evidence: The low two bits of UnitSlotRecord +12 are added directly into melee, ranged, and siege attack helpers.

stats.name: base_melee_attack
stats.semantic_role: primary melee attack rating
stats.evidence: Non-zero values gate standard melee and feed `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveMeleeAttack`.

stats.name: base_ranged_attack
stats.semantic_role: per-type projectile or ranged attack rating
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseRangedAttack` and consumed by `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveRangedAttack` and related projectile combat logic.

stats.name: base_damage
stats.semantic_role: raw per-hit damage value before health scaling
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseDamage` and consumed by `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveDamagePerHit` and `UnitStats_GetBaseDamage`.

stats.name: base_siege_attack
stats.semantic_role: alternate attack rating used in siege or structure-damage contexts
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseSiegeAttack` and consumed by `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveSiegeAttack`.

stats.name: road_move_cost
stats.semantic_role: move cost on road and bridge overlays
stats.evidence: Returned when the world-map tile record has a road or bridge overlay.

stats.name: terrain_move_cost
stats.semantic_role: terrain-dependent move cost
stats.evidence: Combined with `g_TerrainMoveTableOffsets` in the world movement helpers.

stats.name: unit_type_flags
stats.semantic_role: unit-type bitfield inside the 88-byte metadata record
stats.evidence: Bit0 marks airborne types; another flag controls the 6-vs-10 seed path.

stats.name: attack_range_max
stats.semantic_role: maximum squared projectile range
stats.evidence: Projectile logic rejects shots beyond this value.

stats.name: attack_range_min
stats.semantic_role: minimum squared projectile range
stats.evidence: Projectile logic also rejects shots inside this lower bound.

stats.name: move_pixel_speed
stats.semantic_role: per-frame displacement during movement animation
stats.evidence: Movement loops multiply direction vectors by `byte_512570`.

stats.name: move_tick_delay
stats.semantic_role: delay between movement animation ticks
stats.evidence: `Time_Now` gates movement animation advancement with `byte_512571`.

stats.name: death_animation_frames
stats.semantic_role: number of frames in the death effect
stats.evidence: Copied into the battle death-loop state.

stats.name: death_frame_interval
stats.semantic_role: delay between death-animation frames
stats.evidence: Used by the same death loop that advances the effect frame counter.

stats.name: move_sound_stem
stats.semantic_role: per-unit movement-sound path stem
stats.evidence: Both movement-sound helpers build `sfx\\ruchy\\<stem>...` from the record field at offset `+81`.

stats.name: move_sound_variant_count
stats.semantic_role: number of alternating movement-sound variants
stats.evidence: The current step variant wraps modulo `g_UnitMoveSoundVariantCounts[88 * type]`.

stats.name: move_sound_base_volume
stats.semantic_role: default movement-sound volume
stats.evidence: Both movement-sound helpers pass `g_UnitMoveSoundBaseVolumes[88 * type]` into `CSS_PlaySound`.

relationships.evidence: Type 13 is explicitly rejected by ordinary melee handlers.
Type 29 is grouped with siege units in the looped-movement-audio path.
The `smok` record belongs to the airborne class governed by `g_UnitTypeFlags` bit0.
Projectile-capable units use `g_UnitTypeBaseRangedAttack` together with the range tables.
Projectile combat paths pair the ranged attack helper with `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveDamagePerHit`.
Projectile logic compares squared distance against `g_UnitTypeMaxRange`.
Airborne units use digit-only movement-sound suffixes instead of terrain-surface suffixes.
Light units seed at 6 rather than 10.
